about_the_game:
What if Splatoon and Mario Kart had a baby and that baby learned card tricks?

Splash & Dash is an 8-player paint-splattering combat racer where drifting isn't just for show it refills your paint tank. Cover the arena in your colour to claim territory. Ram opponents off the map. Then break the whole game wide open with deck-building power cards that evolve your playstyle every single match.

Friendship ends here. Legends get born.

Splash&Dash

Splatoon meets Mario Kart with a deck-building twist. Drift to refill your paint tank, splatter the arena to claim territory, and ram your friends into oblivion. 8-player local & online chaos where every match reshapes the meta.

Drift. Splatter. Dominate.

Every drift fills your paint tank. Every painted tile is territory claimed. The player who covers the most ground in their colour wins but everyone's painting over everyone else, all the time. Tracks become living battlegrounds that shift and change with every lap.

Power-ups scattered across the arena give you the edge: speed boosts, paint bombs, shields, and worse. The arena gets messier. The competition gets fiercer. The last thirty seconds of every match are pure pandemonium.

Build Your Deck. Break the Meta.

This isn't just another kart racer. Between rounds, pick cards that permanently upgrade your vehicle for the rest of the match. Stack speed. Go all-in on paint capacity. Build a ramming loadout that turns your kart into a battering ram.

Every card combination creates a different playstyle. Every match plays differently because your opponents are building too. The meta isn't set you set it, live, in real time.

Choose Your Fighter

Three vehicle classes. Three ways to ruin someone's day.

Heavies Built like freight trains. Ram opponents into orbit and paint territory through sheer force. You don't go around problems. You go through them.

Speedsters Slide through corners like they're not there. Leave enormous paint trails in your wake. You're gone before anyone knows what happened.

Standards Balanced, reliable, and deceptively deadly. Jack of all trades, master of winning.

8-Player Chaos. Your Couch or the World.

4-player split-screen on a single screen. 8 players online. Mix and match bring your couch crew into online lobbies and unleash coordinated chaos on strangers.

Solo against AI? They don't go easy. Every match is a full arena whether you've got 8 friends or none.

Customise everything: match length, rules, arenas. Quick 2-minute rounds or 10-minute wars. Your house, your rules.

Every Match Matters

Unlock new characters, wild vehicles, eye-popping paint colours, and game-changing abilities. Every trophy earned shifts what's possible. The more you play, the more the game opens up.

Made by 4 People Who Miss When Games Brought People Together

We're Ghost Budget Games, a 4-person indie studio. We built Splash & Dash because we miss the kind of games that made you forget what time it is. The kind where someone screams at the TV and everyone's laughing. The kind you keep playing long after you said "one more round" for the fifth time.

This is that game.
